title: Spring, the experiment the agent asked for: dry friction confirmed
description: The glider between two springs, the same pull filmed for 20 s instead of 15 (the same public video, which runs longer than the first analysis used). The tie is settled: dry (sliding) friction forecasts the held-out motion within 3.4%, viscous damping misses it by 18.7% and is 12 BIC behind (on the shorter clip it was 4). The natural frequency, 2.7385 rad/s (95%: 2.7378 to 2.7392), agrees with the first analysis.
credit: Video: Pieter Kuiper, Linnaeus University, Wikimedia Commons, Attribution license (3.0 to 23.0 s, re-encoded)
